en: [[You]] [[look]] a little [[tired but excited]] after starting the project, and [[impress]] everyone with your dedication so far.
me: after starting the project, and impress everyone with your dedication so far
easy: and impress everyone with your dedication so far
요약: 프로젝트로 피곤해 보여도 신나 있고, 헌신으로 모두를 감동시키고 있다.
notes: and로 이어진 동사는 같은 모양: look(보이다)과 impress(감동시키다) 모두 주어 you 뒤 현재형

en: [[Close friends]] [[can provide]] [[comfort]] to discouraged or unhappy teenagers, especially when they feel [[really]] alone during difficult times.
key: 가까운 친구들이 위안을 줄 수 있다.
me: to discouraged or unhappy teenagers, especially when they feel really alone during difficult times
easy: 가까운 친구들은 위안을 줄 수 있다.
especially when they feel really alone during difficult times
특히 힘든 시기에 정말로 외롭다고 느낄 때.
요약: 힘들고 외로운 십대에게 친한 친구가 큰 위안이 된다.
notes: 형용사를 꾸미는 말은 부사: alone(외로운)을 꾸미려면 real(진짜의, 형용사)이 아니라 really(정말로, 부사)

en: [[The team's research topic]] [[is]] [[very new and interesting]], so it is receiving a lot of attention, motivating the researchers to keep exploring and [[to publish]] their findings soon.
key: 그 팀의 연구 주제는 매우 새롭고 흥미롭다.
me: , so it is receiving a lot of attention, motivating the researchers to keep exploring and to publish their findings soon
easy: The topic is new and interesting
so it is receiving a lot of attention
motivating the researchers to keep exploring and to publish their findings soon
연구자들이 계속 탐구하고 곧 결과를 발표하도록 동기를 주면서.
요약: 주제가 새롭고 흥미로워 관심을 받고, 연구자들이 계속 연구하게 한다.
notes: to부정사끼리 병렬: to keep exploring and to publish(발표하다). to 뒤에는 동사원형이라 to publishing ✕
motivate A to 동사원형 = A가 ~하도록 동기를 주다

en: [[Noam]] [[will join]] [[a tennis club]] even though he is neither drawn to sports nor skilled at them, and never has he felt this excited about a new hobby before.
me: even though he is neither drawn to sports nor skilled at them, and never has he felt this excited about a new hobby before
easy: Noam will join a tennis club
even though he is neither drawn to sports nor skilled at them
never has he felt this excited about a new hobby before
그는 전에 새 취미에 이렇게 신난 적이 없다.
요약: 운동에 소질은 없어도 처음으로 이렇게 신나서 테니스 클럽에 들어간다.
notes: never 같은 부정어가 문장 맨 앞에 오면 조동사 + 주어 + 동사 순서로 도치: never has he felt
예: Never did I see(see 보다) him. / He has never felt (원래 어순)

en: Before I went up on stage to speak, [[Ms. Miller]] [[gave]] [[me]] [[encouraging and useful advice]], delivered in a calm and [[reassuring]] tone that put me at ease.

, delivered in a calm and reassuring tone that put me at ease
easy: Before I went up on stage to speak
delivered in a calm and reassuring tone that put me at ease

notes: and 앞뒤는 같은 모양: calm(차분한) and reassuring(안심시키는) → 둘 다 명사 tone을 꾸미는 형용사
reassuring = 안심시키는 (reassure 안심시키다의 -ing). 말투가 상대를 안심시키니 능동 -ing
